intro.title: Transforming West Africa's Cashew Industry
intro.content: At AfriNuts Export, we're not just building a business - we're creating a movement that combines ethical agribusiness, Islamic values, and sustainable development to revolutionize the cashew sector in Ivory Coast and beyond.

cta.title: A Movement Rooted in Vision
cta.content: Our goal is not just profitability — but to transform our region into a hub of ethical agribusiness. We're planting 3,500 cashew trees today to nourish the next generation — with faith, purpose, and excellence.

esg.title: Our Commitment to ESG
esg.content: At AfriNuts, our vision is deeply aligned with Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles. We are building a carbon-neutral, zero-waste cashew supply chain powered by renewable energy, organic farming, and blockchain traceability. Our social mission prioritizes fair trade, local job creation, clean water access, and Islamic financial ethics, reinvesting in the community and empowering future generations. With full transparency, ethical investor terms, and a commitment to sustainability at every step, AfriNuts is proud to be Africa's ESG-first cashew initiative.

roadmap.title: Our Strategic Roadmap: From Farm to Global Brand

items.title: Foundation Phase: Farm Established
items.description: Successfully planted and secured our 35-hectare cashew farm in Odienné. This foundational asset is now operational and growing.

items.title: Certification & Planning
items.description: Initiate Organic certification process for the farm. Finalize engineering designs and secure permits for the processing center.

items.title: Build-Out: Processing Center Construction
items.description: Break ground and construct our Phase 1 semi-automated processing facility. Secure Halal and ISO 22000 certification.

items.title: Commissioning & First Harvest
items.description: Install equipment, train staff, and commission the plant. Process our farm's first commercial harvest into samples for global buyers.

items.title: Scale & Global Export
items.description: Begin full commercial operations and first exports of certified AfriNuts products to Europe and the Middle East. Reinvest profits to plan for Phase 2 industrial expansion.
